$comment: What a trusted theme plugin may set through contributes.partStyles (ADR-0007: emitted in @layer plugins). Read by the kernel's manifest check (crates/wisp-kernel/src/part_styles.rs, include_str!) and by the shell's compiler (part-styles.ts), so a manifest that installs is exactly what the app applies. A key is a data-part name (`composer.send`), `:root` (token overrides: custom properties only) or a theme group `@light` / `@dark` holding the same map. A property is one of `properties` or a custom property (`--accent`). A value is plain CSS text: no `;`, braces, angle brackets, backslash, `@`, `!`, comments, control characters or unbalanced quotes; `url()` only with a `data:image/` URL; no image-set() or src().
